profile_text.body:
CGI is an IT and business consulting services firm that has operated since 1976, according to its website. The company describes itself as one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world and marks a 50-year milestone, which it frames as a history of serving clients and building what it calls a global culture of ownership. It is a public company traded under the ticker GIB.

On AI, CGI says it consults with leaders on scaling AI through strategy, governance and execution, and it markets AI-ready banking services aimed at resilience, innovation and long-term growth. One example it gives is work with a large building materials manufacturer on accelerating business intelligence migration planning using an AI-enabled assessment. No specific AI products are tracked for the company, and its record shows no litigation or other legal cases.
